description: Fail-closed generated inventory for every delivered named route, rendered Blade page view and global/contextual navigation reference. Runtime route metadata and exact source markers are authoritative; this policy file contains only bounded classification exceptions.

route_overrides.rationale: The robots endpoint is a machine-consumed plain-text policy resource rather than an interactive rendered portal screen or navigation destination.

direct_entry_routes.rationale: The MFA challenge is reached by the authenticated login continuation and is intentionally not exposed as a normal global or contextual navigation destination.
The password reset form is entered through a bounded expiring notification token and must not be linked from ordinary portal navigation without that token.
The new-address confirmation screen is entered through a bounded signed token delivered to the pending address and is not a normal navigable portal page.
The old-address recovery screen is entered through a bounded recovery token and intentionally has no global or contextual navigation entry.

nonclaims: Repository route/view/navigation closure does not prove production deployment correctness or production reachability.
A route bound to a Blade view and navigation source does not prove every runtime state or browser permutation.
This contract performs no production, staging, Canary, schema, payment-provider or user-data mutation.
